question: The sides of a triangle are 72 cm, 90 cm, and 54 cm. What is its area? (in cm² )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify if the sides form a **Pythagorean triplet**.

Divide sides 54, 72, 90 by 18 → 3, 4, 5. (Standard triplet)

Since it is a **right-angled triangle**, Area = 1/2 × base × height.

Area = 1/2 × 54 × 72 = 27 × 72 = 1944 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 1944 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sides **a = 72 cm**, **b = 90 cm**, **c = 54 cm**.

**Formula Used:** Heron's Formula Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)], where s = (a+b+c)/2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1130f885ef057f4a4db328f939e8ed12108b7a4d8a34d0f8d3abb577ffc84209.png] 

⇒ Semi-perimeter (s) = (72 + 90 + 54) / 2

⇒ s = 216 / 2 = 108 cm

⇒ Area = √[108 × (108 − 72) × (108 − 90) × (108 − 54)]

⇒ Area = √[108 × 36 × 18 × 54]

⇒ Area = √[(54 × 2) × 36 × 18 × 54] = √[54² × 36 × 36]

⇒ Area = 54 × 36 = 1944 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1944 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Right-Angled Triangle Property

If a² + b² = c², the triangle is right-angled and its area is simply 1/2 × base × height.

Heron's Formula

Used for any triangle with sides a, b, and c: Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)] where s is the semi-perimeter.

Equilateral Triangle Area

For a triangle with all sides equal to 'a', Area = (√3 / 4) × a².</p
